name: LibreTranslate
description: Free, open-source machine translation API that runs entirely offline with no third-party dependencies.

env.label: Enable API Keys
env.description: Require API keys for requests (enable to restrict access)

env.label: Languages to Load
env.description: Comma-separated list of language codes to load (e.g. en,es,fr). Leave empty to load all languages.

env.label: Character Limit
env.description: Maximum number of characters per translation request (leave empty for no limit)

env.label: Request Rate Limit
env.description: Maximum number of requests per minute per client (leave empty for no limit)

env.label: Enable Suggestions
env.description: Allow users to submit translation suggestions

env.label: Disable Web UI
env.description: Disable the web interface and only expose the API
